chapter_title: Concerning the Ad[vent] of the Apostle.
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation of K ephalaia ¶24

The Divine opened within me the interior understanding that had been sealed — the truth concerning spiritual re alities that cannot be known by the external mind, nor g rasped through any succession of merely natural states of thought . He opened to me the perception of the in most and the ou termost degrees of the mind simultaneously : how wisdom and falsity exist in their distinct orders , and how they stand in eternal opposition .

He disclosed how the love of self and the persu asions of falsity first stir red up spiritual combat — the un ce asing assault that evil and the false wage against every good and every truth within the human mind — and how fals ity of itself propag ates this war, extending its domin ion into every faculty it can reach.

Then he further opened my understanding to perce ive how Divine wisdom acted upon falsity, and how, through the * com mingling* of good and evil in the fallen human will — truth and falsity dwelling together in a single mind not yet regener ated — the entire present constitution of human spiritual life was established: neither pure celest ial order nor complete spiritual death , but a mixed state , in which redem ption and tem ptation co exist, and within which the work of separation must be accomplished.

---

* A note on the " min gling": * In Swedenborg's doctrine this corresponds precisely to the * va station * state — the condition after the Fall in which goods and evils, tru ths and falsities, are not yet distinguished within the human being . The " universe set up" through min gling is not the created cosmos but the ** composite spiritual constitution ** of unre generate humanity, which exists so that freedom , and therefore reformation , remains possible.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: the hidden mystery, the one that is hidden from the worlds and the generations, the mystery of the depths and the heights. He unveiled to me the mystery of the Light and the Darkness; the mystery of the calamity of conflict, and the war, and the great [upheaval], the battle that the Darkness spread about. Afterwards, he unveiled to me also: How the Light [subdued] the Darkness, through their mingling this universe was set up [and ordered in a mingled condition, so that the Light might be refined and separated from the Darkness. He also unveiled to me]

the way that the ships were constructed; to enable the gods of Light to be in them, to purify the Light from creation. Conversely, the dregs and the effluent [shall be cast down] to the abyss. The mystery of the fashioning of Adam, the first man. Also, the mystery of the tree of knowledge, which Adam ate from; his eyes saw.
